title: Morphisms in a right localization are a colimit of ordinary Hom sets
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, $S$ a multiplicative system, and $Q':\mathcal C\to S^{-1}\mathcal C$ its right localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For objects $M,N$ of $\mathcal C$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_{t:P\to M\,\in S}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(P,N)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{S^{-1}\mathcal C}(M,N)$ is a bijection.
